message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in Path('repo-vul/src-vul/flac/oss-fuzz/seedcorpus/fuzzer_tool_flac').glob('*.fuzz'):
    b=p.read_bytes(); i=b.find(b'fLaC'); print(p.name, i, b[:i])
    if i>=0:
        off=i+4; hdr=b[off:off+4]; print('hdr',hdr.hex(), 'type',hdr[0]&0x7f,'len',int.from_bytes(hdr[1:4],'big'))
        si=b[off+4:off+4+34]
        if len(si)>=18:
            x=int.from_bytes(si[10:18],'big')
            sr=(x>>44)&((1<<20)-1); ch=((x>>41)&7)+1; bps=((x>>36)&31)+1; total=x&((1<<36)-1)
            print('sr,ch,bps,total',sr,ch,bps,total,'bytes10-18',si[10:18].hex())
PY` executed with exit code 0.
